# ATHENOA

> ATHENOA is a Cultural Sanctuary which rekindles Ancient Hellenic Wisdom as a living path of self-realization, sacred education, and civic virtue.

Guided by the Archetype of Goddess Athena, we illuminate the way from intellectual learning to embodied knowing, from philosophy to inner awakening—restoring our relationship with Nature, with Soul, and with the World.

### Benefits of Joining ATHENOA

Would you like to explore deep spiritual wisdom, and the non-dual teachings of key ancient philosophers?

#### You will have the opportunity to learn about Greek spiritual tradition of Awakening,

*You will walk the philosophical path experientially, with safety and support at every step. You will come into contact with your spiritual roots, and you will receive the proper, holistic Greek Education and the psycho-mental cultivation that they did not give us in schools - and which is now rarely provided by the existing social - educational system.*

#### You will be methodically and properly trained in Greek Philosophy and the Ancient Hellenic Scriptures

In an era when over- and misinformation, the proper foundations, the methodical, precise and grounded Education, without “detours” and rhetoric devoid of practical substance, are the elements that characterize the authentic thinker and practitioner of Philosophy.

#### You will follow in the footsteps of Education followed by the Ancient Sages

After many years of research and work, for the first time in modern times, our School introduces a pioneering Study structure based on the Ancient Curriculum of the Platonic Academy - which operated for approximately 1000 consecutive years, from 387 BC - 529 AD!

## About Dr. Athena Potari

https://www.athenoa.academy/en/about-athena/

Dr. Athena Despoina Potari is a Doctor of Philosophy at the University of Oxford, holder of a Master’s Degree specializing in Platonic Polity and Cosmology, and founder of the Philosophical Academy “ATHENOA”.

The purpose of founding the Academy is to highlight Greek Philosophy and to teach it as a Living Spiritual Tradition, with the main goal of Awakening of Consciousness and Εὖ Ζῆν (Good Living).

Athena Potari’s vision is the continuation and revival of the Platonic Academy. With the founding of the Philosophical Academy ATHENOA, she gives flesh and bones to this vision and undertakes the Teaching of Philosophy in combination with Science and Spirituality, as a Path of Self-Knowledge and Awakening, with its direct and experiential application in our lives.

### Athena’s Path

Athena grew up in the beautiful nature of Attica, in the northern suburbs of Athens, in a house nestled in pine-covered gardens and Apollonian light, in a family of mathematicians. Pythagorean Teaching, Music, and Mathematics were the first endowments she received from her parents, already from the age of four. Love for Greece and Philosophy were innate elements that emerged very early, and so she devoted herself to the study of Greek Philosophy from a young age.

She received the Call from Plato at the age of fourteen - after a shattering spiritual experience, triggered as she was reading the Ancient Dialogues. It was a lightning-like activation of Mnemosyne.

She graduated from Athens College with Distinction and Awards in Greek Language, Literature, and Rhetoric, and continued with distinguished university studies abroad, focused mainly on Greek Political Philosophy.

She received her Master’s Degree with Distinction from the LSE, specializing in Platonic Philosophy and more specifically in Plato’s “Republic” and in Political Cosmology. She continued with doctoral studies at the University of Oxford, where a few years later she was awarded the title of Doctor of Political Philosophy, and where she also served as a lecturer in Political-Platonic Philosophy.

In 2020, she was honored with the Philosophy Award of the Academy of Athens for her study on the work of Aristotle. In the same year, she received a research fellowship at the Center for Hellenic Studies of Harvard University in America. Her research explored new horizons in approaching Philosophy, inspired by the history of known and unknown Wise Women - the Ancient Greek women philosophers.

She has taught at the Universities of Oxford, Athens, Patras, Toulouse 1-Capitole, and at the National Defence School. She is a member of the Central Committee of the Scientific Community for the study of the post-materialist paradigm, the Galileo Commission.

In 2022, she published with the same organization the “Call for the Regeneration of the Spirit in the Humanities,” inviting the reintegration of the Spiritual Dimensions of Human Existence into Academic Research, based on the Model and Principles of Hellenism.

In parallel with her studies, and recognizing that the existing academic system could not respond to the deep soulful calling she felt for the Path of Light, she devoted herself for two decades to another, parallel Mathesis (discipleship): Spiritual and Inner Study.

She traveled the world in search of the Light and studying Ancient Civilizations. She was initiated by Teachers of Ancient Spiritual and Healing Traditions, the timeless Spiritual Teaching of the Light, and especially the Orphic–Pythagorean Tradition. Among other things, in 2010 she received the degree of Master Usui Reiki.

She spent long periods of ascetic and meditative practice close to the greatest Teacher… Mother Nature, mainly in the mountains, until she realized and experienced that what she was seeking was already here: first of all, within her and secondly, in the cradle of the Spiritual Light from which she had set out - our Blessed Greece.

In 2019, these two streams of her life, academic and inner study, were united in the founding of the Academy of Hellenic Wisdom ATHENOA, dedicated to the Guide-Protector of Philosophy and Goddess of Wisdom - the Goddess Athena.

The School seeks the continuation of the Platonic Academy, approaching Greek Philosophy as a living, experiential spiritual tradition that combines Scientific Reason with Self-Knowledge, Mystagogy, and Spirituality, with the ultimate aim of the Awakening of Consciousness and the activation of Εὖ Ζῆν (Good Living).

At the Academy, the in-depth study of Ancient Texts, Dialectics, Interdisciplinarity that unites the Philosophical, Theological, and Psychological with the Physical and Cosmological dimensions of Knowledge, Etymology and contact with the all-powerful Ancient Greek Language, are complemented by the teaching of direct experiential practices and tools of spiritual technology, such as: Meditations, Methods of Self-Knowledge, Ancient Hieratic Art, Orphic Hymns, direct study of Consciousness, as well as ethical criteria for action in daily life.

In this way, Philosophy is approached not as a vague theoretical knowledge, but is highlighted as a Way of Life - and, according to Plato’s words, as a Polity of the Soul.

The goal of the Academy is the Promotion of the Hellenic Teaching, the Revival of the Greek Spiritual Tradition, and the Fulfillment of the Apollonian Command: Γνῶθι Σαυτόν “Know Thyself”.

### Odyssey

https://www.athenoa.academy/en/courses/odusseia/

In this Cycle of Studies in Greek Philosophy we will study the Odyssey as a timeless treasure of Wisdom, a symbolic Map of the human Soul and of its Journey to Self-knowledge and Awakening.

- With Dr. Athena Despoina Potari
- Introductory lesson - Presentation of the Cycle: Monday 23 November 2026, 19:30 Greek time
- First lesson: Thursday 26 November 2026, 19:30
- Then: every Thursday at 19:30
- 24 weekly lessons · 8 months
- Live on Zoom, with recordings
- Language: Greek
- Tuition: €550 or 8 × €68.75

#### Course Description

> “Always keep Ithaca in your Mind.To arrive there is your destination.”

Awe touches the Soul as it approaches the ever-flowing spring of Homer, the Source of the Tradition, over which our most ancient forefathers have leaned, generation after generation, for centuries: all those who drew close around the fire of Homer and the Primordial Wisdom recorded, historically, mythologically and mystically, in the great masterworks of the Epics. The eternal Archetypes that tell a primordial story, an age-old journey, familiar and mysterious: the journey of our very own Soul.

We will decode, Philosophically, Psychologically, Experientially and Initiatically, the deeper symbolism and the hidden Wisdom of the Homeric Epic. We will come into contact again with the Ancient Greek Language, with its vibration and its etymology, which has the power to illuminate the Mind and awaken the Soul.

**Odysseus is Us.**

We, the Soul. We, Consciousness.

We, the Human being with the divine spark (or the divine spark in human form!), who journeys through the visible and invisible universes of Matter, of Spirit, of Mind, of relationships, crossing seas between mortal and immortal, oblivion and truth, sleep and Awakening.

It is no accident that as he finally reaches Ithaca, Odysseus is asleep.So he does not, strictly speaking, arrive in Ithaca.Rather, he Wakes Up in Ithaca.

**For Ithaca *Is* Awakening.**The Awakened state of Consciousness that Remembers its true Self.This is its Νόστος, its return home: Remembrance.The State of Presence, of Truth (Α-λήθεια, un-forgetting), the Recognition of Who I Am beyond the dreams of a consciousness asleep.

Homer’s Odyssey, as a primordial Code of the Greek Spirit, carries a unique quality, a hue of its divine nature and origin: it describes at once all the journeys of all our hypostases. It speaks to us of the relation of the One to the Many. The Passage from Unity to Multiplicity. The Journey of the Soul into existence. And the path of our Soul’s Awakening.

For the Odyssey is Life itself, the course of incarnation, and indeed of all incarnations, within the cyclical orbits of the god-made Aeons.

It tells of our very own journey on Earth, through the much-suffering, many-turning human experience.

> ~ “The Laestrygonians and the Cyclopes, wild Poseidon”, whom “you will not meet, unless you carry them within your soul.”

Yet this journey is neither arbitrary nor uncharted. It bears Archetypal Elements, Structure and Stations. The trials we face, the challenges, the passions, the oblivion, are not unique to each of us. They are, archetypally and eternally, the same. The Universe has ways, constants and laws. Even the scenarios of oblivion and the simplicity of un-forgetting are constant.

All of this is mapped in the living guide of the Odyssey, a timeless handbook… for navigating life. Here we meet the distillation of Wisdom. For this handbook, this sacred epic, describes at once, on parallel levels, all the philosophical, theological, physical, historical, ontological and psychological dimensions of life and of our Soul’s journey to the Νόστος of Remembrance, which for Socrates is the very definition of Knowledge.

That is why the Goddess Athena, the Goddess of Knowledge and Wisdom, keeps ever-watchful guard at the side of Odysseus as his guide, handing Wisdom down from generation to generation into the hands of every Odysseus: You and Me, All of us.

**What do the Cyclopes, Circe, the Sirens and Calypso symbolize? What is the deeper meaning of the trials of Odysseus? What is the role of the Goddess Athena? What does Penelope symbolize? What is Ithaca?**

Through Greek Philosophy, Mythology and experiential exercises of Self-knowledge, we will follow the archetypal journey of the Soul to Awakening, with Homer’s handbook as our guide.

#### The Cycle of Studies Includes

- 24 live, interactive online Lessons on Zoom
- Links to watch each lesson at your own time, in audio-visual form (video and audio/mp3), once its live broadcast is over
- Access to All the lesson videos and the Study Material for one year
- Study of the 24 Rhapsodies of the Odyssey, in contact with the original text and the Etymology of the Ancient Greek Language, delving into the Philosophical, Psychological, Spiritual and Symbolic meanings of the Homeric Epic
- A combination of the Dialectical Tradition, the Study of Ancient Texts & Scientific Knowledge with Experiential Exercises of Self-knowledge & Meditations
- Connecting Homeric Wisdom with the riches of Ancient Greek Philosophy, through original interpretive approaches and selected ancient texts
- Certificate of Attendance for the Cycle of Studies
- Question-and-Answer sessions and scholarly dialogue that encourage direct participation and interaction
- Additional Bibliography and Notes
- Participation in an active, inspired Online Community of Students & Friends of Philosophy that fosters learning among students (optional)

### Εὖ Ζῆν

https://www.athenoa.academy/en/courses/eu-zen/

Philosophy as the Art of Living: an experiential path to becoming, each day, who we truly are.

- With Dr. Athena Despoina Potari
- Introductory lesson - Presentation of the Cycle: Monday 23 November 2026, 19:30 Greek time
- First lesson: Tuesday 1 December 2026, 19:30
- Then: Tuesdays at 19:30, about two lessons a month
- 16 lessons, about two a month · 8 months
- Live on Zoom, with recordings
- Language: Greek
- Tuition: €640 or 8 × €80

#### Course Description

> “A path of Self-knowledge, Truth, Virtue, Eros and Freedom, whose aim is to return Philosophy to its primordial mission: Awakening, Freedom & the Art of Εὖ Ζῆν.”

At its core lies the ancient Greek ideal of Εὖ Ζῆν, living well. The Cycle of Studies «Εὖ Ζῆν: Philosophy as the Art of Living» is an experiential path of 16 lessons, dedicated to the practical application of Ancient Greek Wisdom in our everyday life, as a living path of Self-knowledge, of the cultivation of Virtue, of reconnection with our Authenticity and of the Awakening of the Soul. We will explore how the timeless Wisdom of the Greeks can illuminate the deepest questions of human existence, guide us through the challenges of everyday life, and transform Philosophy from an object of knowledge into lived experience and a way of life.

Unlike the Cycles that focus on the systematic study of one particular ancient work, here we will travel through selected passages of the Greek Philosophical Tradition and the study of the ancient Greek Language and its etymology, approaching by theme some of the most fundamental and timeless questions of human life.

Through the meeting of philosophical study with personal reflection, dialectic and experiential practice, we will seek to rediscover Philosophy in its original mission:

**Not simply how to learn more, but how to become, every day, That which we truly Are.**

#### Indicative Themes

**Unit I: Know Thyself (ΓΝΩΘΙ ΣΑΥΤΟΝ)***The Mystery of the Self and the Awakening of Consciousness*

- What does it mean to Live Truly? What is Eudaimonia?
- What is true Παιδεία, education of the whole person, and what follows from its absence?
- **Who Am I? What are Mind and Consciousness?** Through Plato’s Cave we explore the nature of Mind and Consciousness, the habits and unconscious programs that shape us, in search of Self-knowledge and Awakening.

**Unit II: The Return to Inner Truth***From Self-knowledge to Inner Connection*

- **What is the Soul and what forces govern it? How do I hear my inner voice? How will I find my Οικειοπραγία, the doing of my own work? Why do I feel sorrow?** We delve into the threefold nature of the Soul, into Truth and inner connection, into trauma and Freedom. We seek our Οἰκεῖον Ἔργον, our proper work, and the possibility of our work becoming an ally of our true Nature.
- **What is Virtue? How are the Four Cardinal Virtues cultivated? What does it mean to live Κατὰ Φύσιν, according to Nature? How does Philosophy become everyday practice?** We explore Virtue, the Four Cardinal Virtues, the Aristotelian Mean and living Κατὰ Φύσιν, as the foundations of a life of Truth, Freedom and Eudaimonia.

**Unit III: Eros, Love and Human Relationships***The Other as a Mirror of the Soul*

- What is Eros? Why do we fall in love?
- Conscious partnership: how do we create conscious relationships? Freedom and Love
- How do my family roots and the wounds of the past affect me?

**Unit IV: The Soul in the World***From Knowledge to Virtue, Psychopolitics and Lived Wisdom*

- **Why Is This Happening to Me Now? Justice & Ειμαρμένη: the Greek Counterpart of Karma?** Ancient views of responsibility, retribution and catharsis, in dialogue with the idea of karma. The relation between Fate and Freedom. Is there a deeper order in the events of our lives?
- **Psychopolitics.** How is individual Consciousness connected with collective Consciousness and with Politics? How can we realize our Nature as “political beings”?

#### The Cycle of Studies Includes

- 16 interactive online Lessons on Zoom (about 2 lessons a month)
- The option to watch at your own time: links to each lesson in audio-visual form (video and audio/mp3) are sent once its live broadcast is over
- Access to All the lesson videos and the Study Material for one year
- A combination of the Dialectical Tradition, the Study of Ancient Texts & Scientific Knowledge with Experiential Exercises of Self-knowledge & Meditations
- Certificate of Attendance for the Cycle of Studies
- Question-and-Answer and Dialogue sessions, for interaction and for putting the teaching into practice
- Additional Bibliography and Notes
- Participation in an active, inspired Online Community of Students & Friends of Philosophy that fosters learning among students (optional)

### The Hidden Non-Duality of Ancient Greek Philosophy

https://www.athenoa.academy/en/courses/the-hidden-non-duality-of-ancient-greek-philosophy/

Each week we will delve into the non-dual teaching expressed by the following great Philosophers ~ Ancient Sages: Plotinus, Plato, Pythagoras, The Pre-Socratics

- With Dr. Athena Despoina Potari
- From January 2027
- Four weekly meetings
- Live on Zoom, recordings for 120 days
- Language: English

#### Course Structure & Content

Each week we will explore the non-dual teachings in the work of the following great Philosophers ~ Ancient Sages:

- **Plotinus: Nous and Logos; the One and/ (as) the Self \* *“It is not a View, it is a Union”***
- **Plato: The Hidden non-duality behind the - apparent - Platonic duality \* *One, Eros & Beauty, and Socrates’ secret Female Master***
- **Pythagoras: The Initiate of the Egyptian Pyramids who invented the term “*Philosopher*” \* “*You will realize you were never a mortal*”**
- **The Presocratics: Heraclitus – Parmenides: At the start of the Journey: *En* and *Polla* ~ *The One and the Many***

In our four meetings we will **study** excerpts from key ancient texts (presented by Athena in English translation) in a dialectical way, **decode** their initiatory spiritual etymology, and weave our inquiry with **meditations, contemplation, embodied practices and dialogue**, with a live **QnA** with Athena and our course community.

The discussion will also involve **allusions to mythology**, theology and even poetry and the Arts, as expressions of meaning and teachings pertaining to the holistic non-dual View of Hellenism.
